labels.reason: All supplied source units on this single page were reviewed. Three whole-lung mean concentration records support availability of digitized group-level PMB observations after the stated rabbit IT regimen. Marker labels identify plotted records, not animals. DR001 has source-backed drug identity and PK classification. DR002, DR003, DR006 and DR007 have partial input support, with unresolved concentration basis, dose basis, formulation, sampling design and uncertainty definitions. DR004 and DR008 are supported by explicit discrepancy and exploratory-use notes, without reconciliation or a component-identifiability decision. DR011 has explicit negative retrieval evidence for measured rabbit fu, rather than an available binding measurement. These partial requirements remain UNRESOLVED. The source's exploratory designation is retained as source context; it does not establish scientific eligibility or predictive validity.

findings.reason: MI004 remains AMBIGUOUS and OPEN, needed_at prepare, originating in main:/missing_information/items/3. This page identifies contexts requiring review: A178 reports Methods n=3-4/time versus caption n=3/time for Tissue/ELF; A177 reports plasma figure times/count differing from the blood protocol, especially SC; A180 reports an SC whole-lung Figure 2 peak differing from Table S5 Cmax. The latter notes concern other matrices or routes and do not establish a numerical conflict in this IT curve. Exact discrepant plasma and SC peak values are not supplied. No source has been selected or reconciled; dependent reconciliation remains pending.
findings.needed_material: At preparation, review the cited methods, caption, Figure 2 and Table S5 under authorized retrieval; retain each value with study, route, matrix, units and locator, determine applicability to this IT curve, and record the MI004 outcome before source selection.

findings.reason: PMB, IT, whole lung, mg/kg and mg/L are supplied, but formulation, salt/free-base/activity dose basis and total versus unbound concentration basis are NOT_FOUND. No conversion input or physiological bridge is supplied. Whole lung cannot be relabeled as ELF, BAL or plasma.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed formulation, dose-basis and concentration-basis definitions, or an explicit unresolved disposition before any affected conversion or cross-matrix linkage.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: three digitized whole-lung mean concentrations, times, pixel coordinates and a single IT regimen are available. Individual IDs and SD were not recovered; the error-bar definition is unavailable and reported counts differ. Serial versus destructive sampling, actual versus nominal interpretation of the Time column, assay BLQ/LLOQ metadata, missingness definitions and source-supported held-out prediction opportunities are NOT_FOUND. The +/-2-pixel allowance is digitization tolerance and cannot supply biological variability. No source-backed individual trajectories or model identifiability result is established.
findings.needed_material: Clarify sampling and time-column definitions, counts, reported variability and assay metadata; preserve digitization provenance and group-level status. Forward unresolved input sufficiency and component identifiability to animal PK without fitting here.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: A180 states that no measured rabbit fu was located. The concentration basis is unspecified, so these whole-lung means cannot be assumed to be direct unbound concentrations. No binding measurement, fraction scale, method, measured matrix, concentration range, temperature, pH, recovery or nonspecific-binding information is supplied. This is a scoped retrieval statement, not proof that rabbit binding evidence does not exist.
findings.needed_material: For any requested rabbit free-exposure endpoint or binding correction, identify permitted source-backed direct free concentrations or applicable binding evidence with its definitions and conditions, or retain the endpoint-specific gap. Do not default fu to one.
